body.text: Two federal stories displaced the NFA injunction overnight — DOJ finalised the gun-rights restoration rule, and the FBI reported the lowest murder rate ever recorded. No coverage peer has touched either.

DOJ released its final firearm-rights restoration rule on Monday and expects upwards of 330,000 applications in the first year; the rule states “at least 20 million adults” could be covered. Separately, the FBI reported violent crime down 9.7 percent and a 2025 murder rate of 4.1 per 100,000 — tied with 1955 and 1956 for the lowest ever measured.

facts.title: 1. DOJ finalises federal firearm-rights restoration process
